description_summary: Use for a contained TypeScript starter fix under roughly 50 lines, such as a schema, route or React component edit; expand to planning if boundaries multiply.
should_trigger: Fix this typo in one mobile component with a contained edit.
Rename this local TypeScript variable and verify the affected package.
Add a small validation guard using the neighboring implementation pattern.
Update one component prop without changing the shared protocol.
Make this bounded API error-message change in the existing module.
should_trigger_test: Stop treating a TypeBox schema change as tiny when several consumers need edits.
Complete this authorized single-workspace fix without an unnecessary planning interview.
should_not_trigger: Create an implementation plan for a feature spanning API, database and clients.
Research official guidance for this TypeScript package design decision.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
